entry.value: library(ComplexHeatmap)%%00010.have_Rutils <- requireNamespace("R.utils", quietly = TRUE)%%00010%%00010# load data%%00010data <- knime.in%%00010%%00010# --- fast 0/1 presence matrix (1 = valid, 0 = missing) ---%%00010X <- as.matrix(data)%%00010P <- !is.na(X)%%00010storage.mode(P) <- "integer" # 1 = valid, 0 = missing%%00010colnames(P) <- colnames(X); rownames(P) <- rownames(X)%%00010%%00010# creates graph subtitle%%00010if (knime.flow.in[["graph_subtitle"]] != ""){%%00010%%00009subtitle = paste("\n ", knime.flow.in[["graph_subtitle"]])%%00010} else {%%00010%%00009subtitle =""%%00010}%%00010%%00010# optionally drop rows with no NA values (your original option)%%00010if (!is.null(knime.flow.in[["hide_rows"]]) && knime.flow.in[["hide_rows"]] == 1) {%%00010 keep <- rowSums(P) != ncol(P) # keep rows with at least one NA%%00010 P <- P[keep, , drop = FALSE]%%00010}%%00010%%00010# --- plotting helpers ---%%00010.plot_raw_heatmap <- function(P, title) {%%00010 Heatmap(P,%%00010 col = c("#dde2e3", "#0f211a"), name = "Values",%%00010 heatmap_legend_param = list(at = c(0,1), labels = c("Missing", "Valid"),%%00010 title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6, fontface = "bold"),%%00010 labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6)),%%00010 show_row_names = FALSE,%%00010%%00009%%00009column_title = title,%%00010 column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8, fontface = "bold"),%%00010 column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),%%00010 use_raster = TRUE,%%00010 cluster_rows = TRUE,%%00010 cluster_columns = TRUE) |>%%00010 draw()%%00010}%%00010%%00010.plot_corr_heatmap <- function(P, title) {%%00010 # P is 1(valid)/0(missing). We want correlation of M = 1(missing)/0(valid)%%00010 # Construct M efficiently without copying twice:%%00010 M <- 1L - P # 1 = missing, 0 = valid%%00010 # columns = variables; rows = samples. cor is O(p^2 * n) and OK for many rows.%%00010 C <- stats::cor(M, use = "everything") # no NAs in M, so 'everything' is fine%%00010 Heatmap(C,%%00010 name = "Miss.\ncorr.",%%00010 col = colorRampPalette(c("#f7fbff", "#08306b"))(100),%%00010%%00009%%00009cluster_rows = TRUE,%%00010 cluster_columns = TRUE,%%00010 show_row_names = TRUE,%%00010 show_column_names = TRUE,%%00010 row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),%%00010 column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 6),%%00010 column_title = title,%%00010 column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),%%00010 use_raster = TRUE) |>%%00010 draw()%%00010}%%00010%%00010# --- try raw heatmap with timeout; fallback to correlation heatmap ---%%00010timeout_sec <- if (!is.null(knime.flow.in[["raw_timeout_sec"]])) knime.flow.in[["raw_timeout_sec"]] else 60%%00010%%00010raw_done <- FALSE%%00010%%00010plot_mode <- if (knime.flow.in[["correlation_heatmap"]] == 0) "raw" else "corr"%%00010%%00010if (plot_mode == "corr") {%%00010 # go straight to correlation%%00010 .plot_corr_heatmap(P, paste("Pairwise missingness correlation", subtitle))%%00010%%00010} else if (plot_mode == "raw") {%%00010 raw_done <- FALSE%%00010 if (.have_Rutils) {%%00010 try({%%00010 R.utils::withTimeout({%%00010 .plot_raw_heatmap(P, paste("Missing values pattern", subtitle))%%00010 raw_done <- TRUE%%00010 message(sprintf("Rendered raw heatmap in under %ds.", timeout_sec))%%00010 }, timeout = timeout_sec, onTimeout = "error")%%00010 }, silent = TRUE)%%00010 } else {%%00010 try({%%00010 on.exit(try(setTimeLimit(cpu = Inf, elapsed = Inf, transient = TRUE), silent = TRUE), add = TRUE)%%00010 setTimeLimit(elapsed = timeout_sec, transient = TRUE)%%00010 .plot_raw_heatmap(P, paste("Missing values pattern", subtitle))%%00010 raw_done <- TRUE%%00010 message(sprintf("Rendered raw heatmap in under %ds (setTimeLimit fallback).", timeout_sec))%%00010 }, silent = TRUE)%%00010 }%%00010%%00010 if (!raw_done) {%%00010 message(sprintf("Raw heatmap exceeded %ds or failed; falling back to correlation heatmap.", timeout_sec))%%00010 .plot_corr_heatmap(P, paste("Pairwise missingness correlation fallback from raw values pattern", subtitle))%%00010 }%%00010}
